rules.category: first digit of MATERIALCODE: 1 Onco Drugs, 2 Other Drugs, 3 Consumables
rules.formulary_class: same month's Item Master: FORMULARY+Category | NON FORMULARY | OUT OF FORMULARY | NOT IN MASTER
rules.groups: A = class starting FORMULARY, B = OUT OF FORMULARY, C = NON FORMULARY
rules.compliance: pooled = A/(A+B) over drugs; mean = average of the onco and non-onco ratios; ratio of sums, never an average of percentages
rules.payer: blank -> CASH; payer_overrides.csv; Payer Master first row by CUSTOMERNAME; else CASH(TPA)
